title: Single-Session ViEtRis® Method for the Emotional Charge of Traumatic Memories: a Pilot Study
official: Deactivation of the Emotional Charge of an Active Trauma With the ViEtRis® Method and Maintenance at 1 Month: an Observational Pilot Study With a Waiting Period
summary: This pilot study examines whether the negative emotion(s) triggered by the memory of a traumatic event disappear during a single session of ViEtRis®, a brief method combining hypnosis, conscious work and bilateral tapping, and whether they remain absent one month later. Participants do not have to recount the traumatic event. Emotional intensity is rated from 0 to 10 at booking, at the start and end of the session, and one month later. Post-traumatic symptoms are also measured with the International Trauma Questionnaire (ITQ). A waiting period of 2 to 4 weeks before the session checks whether emotions decrease on their own.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\-

Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged 18 or over
* Exposure to at least one traumatic event, identified with the ITQ (without recounting it)
* Active trauma at booking and at the start of the session: one or more negative emotions come up spontaneously when thinking back to the event, whatever their intensity (from 1 out of 10)
* Sufficient command of French to complete the questionnaires
* Written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known unstabilised psychotic disorder
* Active suicidal ideation or declared suicide risk
* Ongoing traumatic exposure (e.g., current domestic violence)
* Active alcohol or drug dependence
* Start or change of a psychotropic treatment in the previous month
* Trauma-focused psychotherapy (EMDR, CBT) started in the previous 3 months
* Person under legal protection (guardianship, curatorship)
